verdict.rationale: Mastra's graph-based workflow engine lets workflow steps call agents, branch, and run in parallel, enabling multiple agents to be composed inside one workflow (mastra-gh-3, mastra-docs-37, mastra-docs-36, mastra-docs-38, mastra-docs-35), which covers the core of multi-agent orchestration even though Mastra doesn't use 'handoff'/'crew' terminology. However, a hands-on community report specifically describes branching/orchestration logic across multiple agents as clunky and messy, undercutting full confidence in smooth multi-agent orchestration (mastra-comm-7). Missing for 10: dedicated first-class 'handoff'/'crew' abstraction, worked multi-agent example, and independent confirmation that complex multi-agent workflows work smoothly in production.
